+from __future__ import annotations
+
+_ELLIPSIS = "\u2026"
+
+
+def make_menu_summary(help: str, max_length: int = 60) -> str:
+    """Return a condensed, single-line version of a help string for use
+    in a compact command palette.
+
+    This follows the same rules as
+    :func:`~click.utils.make_default_short_help`: only the first
+    paragraph is used, whitespace is collapsed, a leading ``\\b``
+    no-rewrap marker is ignored, the text stops at the first sentence
+    end that fits, and truncation happens on whole words. When the text
+    is truncated, a single Unicode ellipsis character (``…``) is
+    appended instead of ``...``, and it counts toward ``max_length``.
+
+    :param help: The help text to condense.
+    :param max_length: The maximum length of the returned string,
+        including the ellipsis if one is added.
+    """
+    # Consider only the first paragraph.
+    paragraph_end = help.find("\n\n")
+
+    if paragraph_end != -1:
+        help = help[:paragraph_end]
+
+    # Collapse newlines, tabs, and spaces.
+    words = help.split()
+
+    if not words:
+        return ""
+
+    # The first paragraph started with a "no rewrap" marker, ignore it.
+    if words[0] == "\b":
+        words = words[1:]
+
+    total_length = 0
+    last_index = len(words) - 1
+
+    for i, word in enumerate(words):
+        total_length += len(word) + (i > 0)
+
+        if total_length > max_length:  # too long, truncate
+            break
+
+        if word[-1] == ".":  # sentence end, truncate without ellipsis
+            return " ".join(words[: i + 1])
+
+        if total_length == max_length and i != last_index:
+            break  # not at sentence end, truncate with ellipsis
+    else:
+        return " ".join(words)  # no truncation needed
+
+    # Account for the length of the suffix.
+    total_length += len(_ELLIPSIS)
+
+    # Remove words until the length is short enough.
+    while i > 0:
+        total_length -= len(words[i]) + (i > 0)
+
+        if total_length <= max_length:
+            break
+
+        i -= 1
+
+    return " ".join(words[:i]) + _ELLIPSIS
diff --git a/tests/test_menu_summary.py b/tests/test_menu_summary.py
new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_menu_summary.py
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.menu_summary import make_menu_summary
+from click.utils import make_default_short_help
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("value", "max_length", "expect"),
+    [
+        pytest.param("", 10, "", id="empty"),
+        pytest.param("   \n\t ", 10, "", id="whitespace only"),
+        pytest.param("short", 10, "short", id="fits"),
+        pytest.param("one  two\n\tthree", 60, "one two three", id="collapse"),
+        pytest.param("first para\n\nsecond para", 60, "first para", id="paragraph"),
+        pytest.param("\b\nno rewrap text", 60, "no rewrap text", id="no rewrap"),
+        pytest.param("Hello. World is long.", 60, "Hello.", id="sentence stop"),
+        pytest.param("exactly 12 c", 12, "exactly 12 c", id="exact fit"),
+        pytest.param("abc def ghi", 8, "abc def\u2026", id="exact then more"),
+        pytest.param("abc def ghi", 7, "abc\u2026", id="ellipsis counted"),
+        pytest.param("one two three four", 10, "one two\u2026", id="truncate words"),
+        pytest.param(
+            "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do.",
+            40,
+            "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur\u2026",
+            id="long sentence",
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_make_menu_summary(value, max_length, expect):
+    out = make_menu_summary(value, max_length)
+    assert out == expect
+    assert len(out) <= max_length
+
+
+def test_default_max_length():
+    out = make_menu_summary("word " * 30)
+    assert len(out) <= 60
+    assert out.endswith("\u2026")
+    assert "..." not in out
+
+
+def test_short_help_unchanged():
+    assert make_default_short_help("one two three four", 10) == "one two..."
